question: What arrangement is to be made outside the moat according to this instruction?
premises: The moat is the reference point.
The outside of the moat is specified.
An arrangement is to be made there.
inference: One should make the prescribed arrangement outside the moat.
uncertainties: The form sāhye is obscure and may be a textual or dialectal variant.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, having made the arrangement outside the moat.
